narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think the factors of ninety are only two, three and five.
<bookmark mark='six'/>But six times fifteen is ninety, so six and fifteen are factors too.
<bookmark mark='one'/>One and ninety itself are factors too.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The primes are only the building blocks, not the whole list.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows factors of 90: 2, 3, 5; the card 6 × 15 = 90 appears beside it; 1 and 90 light up; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, make sure every factor has a partner that multiplies with it to the number.
<bookmark mark='count'/>Then add one to each prime count and multiply, and the total must match your list.
